lines: Rahul Bahri may sell up to ₹0.24 crore of shares in the offer for sale, sized at up to 1,800 shares.
Proceeds are up to ₹0.24 crore if all offered shares are sold, at the offer price of ₹1,352.
Retained holding is an estimated ₹0.57 crore at offer price; average cost of acquisition is unknown.
Shares unlocked on 9 Sep 2026, 66 days ago, making this a recent trigger; the money is in hand since 11 Mar 2026.
